snippet.title: This is Bus Bound
snippet.description:
Bus🚍Bound is a driving-focused experience with:

🏙⏫ Seven upgradable districts
🌦🚥 Dynamic weather and realistic traffic
🛠🎨 Line and bus editor
🚌🚐 17 unique bus models
🌐💪 Up to four-player co-op multiplayer

The city is waiting. WISHLIST NOW! ✅
